refreeze.reason: Revision 2 correctly selected CA-1M captures with independent FARO ground truth, but assumed the released CA-1M tar archives also contained depth confidence. Inspection of the acquired calibration archive showed that the release contains ARKit depth and FARO GT depth but no confidence member. The same video IDs exist in ARKitScenes raw, whose synchronized 256x192 confidence PNGs are the authoritative 0/1/2 confidence source. Revision 3 keeps every selected scene unchanged and joins only that confidence sidecar by timestamp.

source.confidenceJoin: nearest same-video timestamp; CA-1M integer nanoseconds to ARKitScenes decimal seconds under a preregistered strict tolerance
source.groundTruth: Per-frame FARO laser-scanner rendered depth registered to the capture camera from CA-1M
source.observedDepth: Per-frame onboard ARKit LiDAR depth from CA-1M
source.selectionPolicy: Choose three CA-1M train captures and five CA-1M val captures that also appear in ARKitScenes metadata with distinct visit IDs. Freeze membership before metric sampling or outcome inspection. Confidence is joined from ARKitScenes raw for the identical video IDs.

rules.selectionRule: Selected scenes remain in the ledger even if difficult, missing frames, poorly calibrated, or negative. Replacement requires a new explicit split revision and invalidates any previously inspected outcome.

note: Revision 3 changes no scene membership. It corrects only the confidence source after the acquired CA-1M calibration tar was found not to contain confidence. No valid metric sample, fitted coefficient, or held-out result existed before this correction.
